timeline.title: 生
timeline.summary: 女真完颜部首领劾里钵之子，统一诸部。
timeline.summary_en: Son of the Wanyan chieftain Helibo, he united the Jurchen tribes.

timeline.title: 起兵反辽
timeline.summary: 聚众誓师反辽，克宁江州，出河店大破辽军。
timeline.summary_en: He swore the clansmen to revolt, took Ningjiangzhou, and routed the Liao at Chuhedian.

timeline.title: 称帝建国
timeline.summary: 称帝建国号大金，建元收国，定都上京会宁。
timeline.summary_en: He took the imperial title, founded Jin with the Shouguo era, and fixed the capital at Huining.

timeline.title: 取辽上京
timeline.summary: 亲征取辽上京临潢府，辽之根本动摇。
timeline.summary_en: He took Linhuang, the Liao Upper Capital, in person, shaking Liao to its roots.

timeline.title: 太祖崩
timeline.summary: 崩于部堵泺西行宫，弟吴乞买继。
timeline.summary_en: He died on campaign; his brother Wuyimai succeeded.

timeline.title: 太祖总评
timeline.summary: 以少击众、以弱灭强，开女真立国之基。
timeline.summary_en: Outnumbered yet triumphant, he laid the Jurchen foundations.

bio_md:
# 金太祖完颜阿骨打 · 主要事迹

完颜阿骨打（1068—1123），女真完颜部人，统一诸部后成为女真联盟首领。天庆四年（1114）聚众誓师反辽，克宁江州，出河店一战大破辽军十万，收国元年（1115）称帝建国号大金，定都上京会宁（今哈尔滨阿城）。

阿骨打以「以寡击众」著称：灭辽之战由他开创，天辅四年（1120）亲取辽上京临潢，辽之根本动摇。他又创女真文字，与宋约「海上之盟」夹攻辽国。

天辅七年（1123）阿骨打崩于军中，弟完颜吴乞买即位，是为[[jin-tai-zong|金太宗]]。灭辽灭宋的功业，由其后人完成，而肇基之人实为阿骨打。

bio_parts_en.value:
Wanyan Aguda (1068-1123) of the Wanyan clan united the Jurchen tribes and became their leader. In 1114 he swore the tribesmen to revolt against Liao, took Ningjiangzhou, and routed a hundred-thousand-strong Liao army at Chuhedian. In 1115 he assumed the imperial title, founding the Great Jin with the Shouguo era, and fixed the capital at Huining (modern Acheng, Harbin).

Aguda was famed for winning against overwhelming odds. He opened the war that destroyed Liao, taking the Liao Upper Capital Linhuang in person in 1120 and shaking Liao to its roots. He created the Jurchen script and made the "Sea Alliance" with Song to attack Liao from two sides.

He died on campaign in 1123; his brother Wanyan Wuyimai succeeded as
. The conquests of Liao and Song were completed by his heirs, but the foundation was Aguda's.
